title: 十三所 Shisan Suo
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: Assumed: a position is known and no block is drawn, so a small default box stands there. Confidence C.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 5.43 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile
reduced towards the size drawn on the plan, to stand clear of its neighbours or the water; moved 4.5 m
stands partly over the water layer: on piers or on a bank too thin for the layer to show

evidence.title: 十三所: surveyed 1994
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 11828, free part
evidence.summary: The 1994 survey names 十三所 as one of three sites probed, with 藻园 and 山高水长. The paying part of the report holds the results: not read. The same words in the texts row are tied to YM73 and YM15; here to the hall YM15-02.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 十三所.
